^next on$
__
const today = new Date();
const tomorrow = new Date(today);
tomorrow.setDate(today.getDate() + 1);

return "next on " + tomorrow.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
__
next on - Expands into "next on" followed by tomorrow's date.
